title: Degree-zero continuity for affine open inverse systems
statement: Let X be a scheme in universe u+1 [def-pc-scheme], J a small cofiltered category in universe u+1 [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and D:J → X.Etale [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] a diagram whose objects have affine underlying schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and open-immersion structural maps to X [def-weil-open-immersion]. Let c be a limit cone for the underlying scheme diagram, and p:c.pt → X a morphism such that c.π_j followed by the structural map of D_j equals p. Let H be a functor between abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], from X to c.pt, supplied with an adjunction hH to direct image along p. For any abelian etale sheaf F on X, let ν be a cocone on D.op ⋙ F.obj with point the sections of H(F) on the terminal etale object of c.pt. Assume that its j-th leg is the hH unit at D_j followed by restriction along the map from the terminal etale object into p-base-change of D_j whose underlying map is pullback.lift(c.π_j, identity) [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then Cocone.mk _ ν is a colimit cocone.

source.place: Lemma 59.51.5, degree-zero continuity on affine neighbourhoods

proof.text: Fix a stage and restrict to its cofinal upper tail. All tail maps are open immersions into an affine scheme. The coordinate rings give a filtered diagram, and Spec of their colimit is the scheme limit; uniqueness of limits identifies it with c.pt.

Apply Stacks Tag 03Q6 in degree zero over that fixed affine stage, to the restriction of F and the identity of the stage. Keep the coefficient universe fixed in this affine-site argument. It identifies the filtered colimit of stage sections with sections of the inverse image at c.pt. This geometric continuity step is the remaining hole, not a use of the upstream theorem whose coefficients live one universe higher.

Inverse image along an open immersion is restriction, so the stage values are F(D_j). Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies the inverse image on c.pt with H and intertwines units. The pullback lift in hν then identifies all the continuity legs with ν. The induced colimit comparison is an isomorphism, hence ν has the colimit universal property.
